intent: Show ranking changes of drugs over years

top_recommendation.description: Rank-over-time (bump) chart — tracks rank changes longitudinally.
top_recommendation.clinical_use: Site or patient ranking across visits
top_recommendation.next_step: generate_canvasxpress_config with description='bump chart of <factor> rank over <time>'

alternatives.description: Box-and-whisker showing median, IQR, and outliers per group.
alternatives.clinical_use: Lab value distributions by arm/visit, PK endpoints
alternatives.next_step: generate_canvasxpress_config with description='boxplot of <numeric> grouped by <factor>'

alternatives.description: Points on x/y axes revealing correlation between two numeric variables.
alternatives.clinical_use: Biomarker vs response, PK/PD, PCA plot by treatment
alternatives.next_step: generate_canvasxpress_config with description='scatter plot of <num1> vs <num2> colored by <factor>'

alternatives.description: Parallel axes — each line is an observation, axes are variables.
alternatives.clinical_use: Multi-endpoint profile per subject, multivariate QC
alternatives.next_step: generate_canvasxpress_config with description='parallel coordinates of <numeric variables> colored by <factor>'
scoring_factors: < 4 numeric cols — parallel coordinates preferred over heatmap

alternatives.description: Individual data points per group — best when n < ~50 per group.
alternatives.clinical_use: Individual lab values, small Phase I cohorts
alternatives.next_step: generate_canvasxpress_config with description='dot plot of <numeric> by <factor>'
